agent_identity_conflict: agent_name and agent_id are mutually exclusive
resume_empty: resume must be a session id or "@latest", not an empty string
tools_empty: tools must name at least one tool; leave it None to stay unrestricted
yolo_approval_unreachable: yolo=True makes an ApprovalPolicy.refuse() gate unreachable; use ApprovalPolicy.auto() (or drop yolo) instead
output_format_invalid: output_format must be one of markdown, json, yaml, toml
world_root_empty: world_root must be a non-empty path when set
approval_declared_tools_empty: ApprovalPolicy.declared() must name at least one tool; use ApprovalPolicy.refuse() for an undeclared bound session
approval_tools_wrong_mode: ApprovalPolicy.tools is only meaningful for mode 'declared', not 'refuse'
approval_handler_wrong_mode: ApprovalPolicy.handler is only meaningful for mode 'callback', not 'auto'
attach_output_unsupported: output enforcement cannot be set on an attached session; the owning runtime decides
attach_fields_unsupported: mode='attach' opens a viewer for spec.resume; it does not attach teams, profiles, tools, names, goals or approval policies — that is the owner's side. Set only resume on this spec (or use mode='own'). Offending fields: name.
spawn_output_unsupported: spawn_session() cannot carry output enforcement (output_format); open the session with open_session(..., mode='own') and engage it afterwards
spawn_fields_unsupported: spawn_session() cannot deliver post-open state to a new runtime child; unsupported fields on this spec: name. Open the session in-process (open_session), attach what you need, dispose, then spawn_session() the same id — resume restores the attachment; or spawn without these fields.
attach_resume_required: mode='attach' needs spec.resume: a viewer attaches to an id
spawn_model_pair_required: spawn_session() routes hosting/model to a NEW runtime as one birth sample; state both, or neither (the child then resolves its model from the root's config).
spawn_birth_effort_pair_required: birth_effort for a new spawned session rides the birth sample and needs the hosting/model pair alongside it; state all three, or open the session in-process (open_session) to set a birth level without a model pair.
